description.text: Checks whether automatic filesystem trim is scheduled and whether its last run completed successfully.

timeout_help.text: Maximum collection time, within the runtime limit.

execution_mismatch.text: Execution evidence did not match the recipe.

execution_failed.text: The observation command failed or exited unexpectedly.

execution_timed_out.text: The observation exceeded its time budget.

execution_policy_rejected.text: The agent rejected execution under its local policy.

execution_spawn_failed.text: The approved observation tool could not be started.

runner_busy.text: The agent is finishing another observation.

output_unsupported.text: Could not read the server’s trim status reliably.

clock_uncertain.text: Could not confirm the time of this trim check.

boot_uncertain.text: The server restarted during this check, or its restart status could not be confirmed.

snapshot_changed.text: Trim status changed during the check. A consistent result is not available yet.

evidence_inconsistent.text: The server reported conflicting trim status information.

package_changes.text: The cached package plan contains upgrades, new dependencies or held-back packages.

package_removals.text: The cached package plan includes removals that need attention.

package_cache_unverified.text: The cached plan contains no changes; repository freshness and local-state consistency remain unverified.

reboot_marker_present.text: A package has left a reboot-required marker.

reboot_assurance_unverified.text: No reboot marker was observed; other reboot needs remain unverified.

fstrim_unit_unavailable.text: Could not find or load the automatic trim schedule or service.

fstrim_timer_failed.text: The automatic trim schedule has failed.

fstrim_condition_skipped.text: The server did not meet the conditions needed for automatic trim.

fstrim_history_unavailable.text: No completed fstrim service history is available.

fstrim_running.text: The trim schedule or service is changing state. Its status is not confirmed yet.

fstrim_schedule_unverified.text: Could not confirm the automatic trim schedule.

fstrim_condition_unverified.text: Could not confirm whether the server meets the conditions for automatic trim.

fstrim_trigger_unconfirmed.text: The latest timer trigger has no confirmed completed service run.

fstrim_observed_success.text: The last trim completed successfully. Automatic trim is scheduled.

unsupported_observation.text: The observation format or evaluator is unsupported.

package_plan_clear.text: No changes in the local package plan. Cached metadata may be outdated; security updates are not independently verified.

reboot_marker_absent.text: No package reboot marker observed. Running software may still need a reboot.

fstrim_context_unavailable.text: Could not confirm the saved trim result or schedule.

fstrim_scheduled.text: Automatic trim is scheduled. No completed run has been recorded yet.

fstrim_awaiting_result.text: Waiting for the scheduled trim to finish or report its result.

fstrim_result_overdue.text: The scheduled trim has not reported completion and is overdue.

skill_disabled.text: Monitoring is disabled globally. Settings and past readings are kept.

enablement_changed.text: Waiting for a new reading after the skill was enabled.

no_assignment.text: No current assignment has been delivered.

baseline_recovery_required.text: Baseline delivery requires credential replacement after a recovery conflict.

contact_unavailable.text: Current agent contact is unavailable. The last observation is historical.

server_clock_uncertain.text: The control-plane clock is inconsistent with retained evidence.

assignment_obsolete.text: Settings changed. A new assignment and observation are needed.

missing_capability.text: The agent does not support the connected observation worker.

no_observation.text: Waiting for the first observation of this assignment.

agent_clock_uncertain.text: Agent timestamps are too far ahead of first receipt.

history_expired.text: The latest observation is older than the 90-day history window.

invalid_thresholds.text: The critical threshold must be greater than the warning threshold.

disk_usage.text: The fullest writable filesystem is {path}, at {percent}% used.

disk_empty.text: No usable writable local filesystem capacity was observed.

disk_incomplete.text: The local filesystem observation is incomplete.

package_output_unavailable.text: A complete local package simulation could not be verified.

usage.1.text: Automatic trim uses the server’s existing fstrim.timer. Enable or change that schedule through your usual server administration.

usage.2.text: Run now rechecks trim status. TinyWarden does not run trim or change the server’s schedule.

usage.3.text: A successful trim result does not prove how much storage the device reclaimed. History lists status checks, not individual trim executions.

notify.trim.fstrim_service_failed.text: The last observed filesystem trim run {detail}.

notify.trim.fstrim_result_overdue.text: The scheduled filesystem trim result is {detail}; successful completion has not been confirmed.

notify.trim.fstrim_observed_success.text: The timer is active and the last recorded filesystem trim run {detail}.

notify.trim.fstrim_scheduled.text: The filesystem trim timer is {detail}; a scheduled run result is still awaited.

notify.trim.fstrim_awaiting_result.text: The filesystem trim timer is {detail}; a scheduled run result is still awaited.

usage.4.text: Last trim is the most recent recorded result; Completed at is the server-reported finish time. That result is retained across restarts for up to 90 days.

usage.5.text: Next scheduled run is the upcoming time reported by the server. If it cannot be confirmed, no date is shown. Override check timing in this server’s Settings.

trim_detail_fstrim_result_overdue.text: A scheduled trim has not reported completion within 24 hours of its expected run. An earlier successful trim does not confirm this run.

trim_detail_fstrim_timer_disabled.text: The server’s automatic trim schedule is turned off or blocked. Enable it through your usual server administration if you want automatic trim.

trim_detail_fstrim_timer_inactive.text: The automatic trim schedule is enabled or present but is not running. Check the server’s trim timer.

trim_detail_fstrim_timer_failed.text: The server reported that its automatic trim schedule failed. Check the server’s trim timer before expecting another automatic run.

trim_detail_fstrim_service_failed.text: The server reported an unsuccessful trim attempt. A later successful completion has not been confirmed. Check the server’s trim service for the cause.

trim_detail_fstrim_condition_skipped.text: The server skipped trim because a required condition was not met. This check cannot determine the underlying cause.

trim_detail_fstrim_unit_unavailable.text: The server’s trim timer or service could not be found or loaded. Automatic trim cannot be confirmed.

trim_detail_fstrim_schedule_unverified.text: The server did not provide a verifiable enabled schedule and upcoming run. No next-run date can be confirmed.

trim_detail_fstrim_condition_unverified.text: The server did not provide enough evidence to confirm the conditions required for automatic trim.

trim_detail_fstrim_context_unavailable.text: Saved monitoring evidence does not match this check. Recheck trim status before relying on the result.

trim_detail_fstrim_running.text: The timer or service was changing state during the check. Recheck its status for a confirmed result.

trim_detail_output_unsupported.text: The server’s response could not be interpreted reliably. Recheck trim status.

trim_detail_clock_uncertain.text: The check could not verify the server’s observation time. A trim result cannot be confirmed from this reading.

trim_detail_boot_uncertain.text: The server’s restart identity changed or could not be verified during this check. Recheck after the server is stable.

trim_detail_snapshot_changed.text: The trim service changed state while being checked. Recheck to get a consistent status.

trim_detail_evidence_inconsistent.text: The server’s trim times or results conflict. Recheck; a completed trim cannot be confirmed from this reading.

trim_detail_fstrim_history_unavailable.text: No completed trim result is available from the server.

trim_detail_fstrim_trigger_unconfirmed.text: The schedule started a trim attempt, but its completion has not been confirmed.
